speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing weakness and fatigue; to better understand your condition, have you noticed any specific triggers, such as heat or standing for long periods? Also, have you experienced any dizziness, palpitations, or changes in your skin color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that; given your recent travel and multiple illnesses, have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unintended weight loss? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Urinary tract infection and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (MS). The combination of weakness, fatigue, and mild diplopia (double vision) is inconsistent with a Urinary Tract Infection; diplopia indicates cranial nerve involvement typical of demyelinating diseases. I need to confirm this with imaging and specific antibody testing. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI, Brain_MRI_With_Contrast.
